summary: Tested Object Interaction System for LOTR 5e RPG. All features working correctly including preset selection, CA/HP calculations, combat mechanics with critical/fumble detection, and object destruction.
critical_code_review_comments: ObjectInteractionSection.jsx is well-structured with clear constants for MATERIALS, SIZES, STATES, DURABILITIES
CA calculation correctly uses material base + state modifier
HP calculation correctly uses size dice × state multiplier
Critical (20) detection doubles damage dice as expected
Fumble (1) detection with 50% weapon damage chance implemented
All data-testid attributes present: start-object-combat-btn, attack-object-btn
context_for_next_testing_agent: Object Interaction System fully functional at /rules > Objetos. Presets load configurations correctly. Combat mechanics working with attack rolls, criticals, fumbles, and destruction detection.

objetos_category_visible.evidence: Card shows 'Interacciones para romper puertas, cofres, cerrojos...'

presets_selection.description: All presets load correctly: Cerrojo común, Cerrojo reforzado, Cofre de madera, Puerta vieja, Puerta de castillo, etc.
presets_selection.evidence: Clicking 'Cerrojo común' sets name='Cerrojo común', material=iron, size=tiny, state=normal, durability=fragile

material_configuration.description: Material dropdown with CA values: Tela (11), Cristal (13), Madera (15), Piedra (17), Hierro (19), Mithril (21), Adamantina (23)
material_configuration.evidence: Selecting Hierro shows CA 19 in preview

size_configuration.description: Size dropdown: Diminuto (1d4/2d4), Pequeño (1d6/3d6), Mediano (1d8/4d8), Grande (1d10/5d10)

state_configuration.description: State modifies CA and HP: Ruinoso (-4 CA, ×0.5 HP), Desgastado (-2, ×0.75), Normal (0, ×1), Reforzado (+2, ×1.25), Obra maestra (+4, ×1.5)

durability_configuration.description: Durability switches between Frágil (lower dice) and Resistente (higher dice)
durability_configuration.evidence: Visible in dropdown and affects HP dice

start_combat_button.description: Button with data-testid='start-object-combat-btn' creates object and starts combat
start_combat_button.evidence: Clicking creates object with logged stats: 'Puerta de castillo creado: CA 17, PG 20 (4d8: [4, 2, 4, 6] × 1.25)'

ca_calculation.evidence: Cerrojo común: iron(19) + normal(0) = 19, Puerta de castillo: wood(15) + reinforced(2) = 17

hp_calculation.description: HP = roll(size dice for durability) × state multiplier

attack_button.description: Button with data-testid='attack-object-btn' performs attack rolls
attack_button.evidence: Button shows '¡Atacar!' and becomes disabled when object is destroyed

combat_log.description: Combat log shows all attack results with color coding
combat_log.evidence: Green for hits, gray for misses, yellow for crits, red for fumbles

hit_miss_detection.description: Attack total compared against CA for hit/miss determination

object_destruction.description: Object destroyed when HP reaches 0, shows success message
object_destruction.evidence: Cerrojo común destroyed: '¡DESTRUIDO!' badge and '¡Éxito! El cerrojo común ha sido destruido.'

reference_tables.description: Reference tables visible: CA by Material, HP by Size, Special Rules
reference_tables.evidence: Tables show all materials with CA and all sizes with dice values

reiniciar_button.description: Reset button appears after combat starts, allows restarting
reiniciar_button.evidence: Button shows 'Reiniciar' and resets combat state

data_testids_verified: start-object-combat-btn - Creates object and starts combat
attack-object-btn - Performs attack roll against object
